shortDescription: Module to manage logical networks in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: clusters
options.description: List of dictionaries describing how the network is managed in specific cluster.

options.name: external_provider
options.description: Name of external network provider. At first it tries to import the network when not found it will create network in external provider.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the network to manage.

options.name: label
options.description: Name of the label to assign to the network.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Maximum transmission unit (MTU) of the network.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the network to manage.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the network be present or absent

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: vlan_tag
options.description: Specify VLAN tag. NOTE - To remove the vlan_tag use -1.

options.name: vm_network
options.description: If I(True) network will be marked as network for VM. VM network carries traffic relevant to the virtual machine.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
